items.title: Somerville opened an RFP for an integrated special-education management platform
items.business: City of Somerville / Somerville Public Schools
items.description: Somerville released RFP S2027-04 on September 16 for an Integrated Special Education Management Platform. The City procurement page lists proposals due October 8, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. and directs vendors to register to receive the proposal package.
why: Fresh September 16 municipal technology RFP
Explicit platform procurement rather than an inferred need
October 8 deadline leaves an active pursuit window

items.title: Watertown Retirement Board opened a private-debt investment-manager RFP
items.description: The Watertown Retirement Board is soliciting qualified private-debt investment managers for a dedicated direct-lending strategy. The municipal defined-benefit system reports about $310 million in assets and expects commitments of approximately $2.5 million to $5 million; proposals are due October 6, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. EDT.
why: Official PERAC notice published September 16
Explicit manager search with an indicated commitment range
October 6 deadline is still actionable

items.title: Cambridge Retirement Board opened a value-added real-estate manager RFP for a mandate up to $30 million
items.description: The Cambridge Retirement Board is evaluating open- or closed-end value-added real-estate managers for a potential mandate of up to $30 million. The official PERAC notice was published September 16 and proposals are due October 19, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. EST.
why: Official September 16 PERAC RFP
Potential mandate is stated at up to $30 million
October 19 deadline provides a useful response window

items.title: Somerville opened an RFQ for owner's project management services for a building master plan
items.description: Somerville released RFQ 27-13 on September 16 for Owner's Project Management services for its Building Master Plan. A virtual briefing is scheduled for September 23 and submissions are due October 7, 2026 at 3:00 p.m.
why: Fresh September 16 professional-services RFQ
Explicit OPM scope tied to a building master plan
October 7 opening date provides an active pursuit window

items.title: Sudbury made bid documents available for a DPW concrete-slab demolition and replacement project
items.description: Sudbury's DPW concrete-slab IFB covers demolition and replacement of the existing slab on grade, including labor, materials, equipment, supervision, permits and testing. Bid forms became available September 16; trade sub-bids are due October 8 and general bids October 22, 2026.
why: Bid package became available September 16
Defined construction scope with separate trade and general-bid dates
Pre-bid site visit is scheduled for September 28

items.title: Haverhill has an open RFP for a fire-alarm inspection and reporting platform
items.description: Haverhill lists RFP011.27 for Fire Alarm Inspection and Reporting Platform services as open, with proposals due October 13, 2026 at 10:00 a.m.
why: Official city bid page confirms the solicitation remains open
Technology and compliance scope is explicit
October 13 deadline provides a workable pursuit window

items.title: Massachusetts library commissioners are sourcing statewide general-reference and research databases
items.description: RFR 27-104 seeks licensed electronic general-reference and research content for statewide library access. Public procurement data lists the opportunity as posted September 14 with responses due December 18, 2026.
why: Fresh statewide digital-content procurement
Long response window through December 18
Multi-year statewide access creates a substantial publisher/platform opportunity
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Board of Library Commissioners / COMMBUYS mirror

items.title: PowerOptions is seeking a utility-bill-management platform for 800+ member organizations
items.description: PowerOptions is soliciting qualified providers for a utility bill management platform serving its consortium of more than 800 nonprofit and public-sector organizations across Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Maine and Connecticut. Proposals are due October 16, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. EST.
why: Direct private/nonprofit RFP
Explicit platform procurement
October 16 deadline provides a workable pursuit window

items.title: Shrewsbury SELCO is bidding Phase 4 of its Fiber-to-the-Premise build
items.business: Town of Shrewsbury / Shrewsbury Electric & Cable Operations
items.description: Shrewsbury/SELCO solicitation BD-25-1324-SELCO-SELCO-131526 covers Phase 4 of its Fiber-to-the-Premise project, including fiber-optic cable installation, splicing and testing. The bid closes September 29, 2026.
why: Active municipal broadband construction bid
Explicit fiber installation, splicing and testing scope
September 29 deadline remains open
items.sourceName: Town of Shrewsbury / SELCO via COMMBUYS mirror

items.title: Boston is seeking a contractor to operate and modernize its coordinated street-furniture program
items.business: City of Boston Property Management Department
items.description: Boston RFP EV00017655 seeks a contractor to manage, maintain, expand and modernize its advertising-supported Coordinated Street Furniture Program, including bus shelters, public toilets, information panels, digital displays and benches. Proposals are due November 4, 2026 at noon.
why: Explicit City of Boston RFP
Large multi-asset operating and modernization scope
November 4 deadline provides substantial pursuit time

items.title: Massachusetts DCR is seeking an operator for the Leo J. Martin Nordic ski facility
items.business: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
items.location: Leo J. Martin Golf Course, Weston, MA
items.description: DCR RFP 2026-800 seeks an operator for the Leo J. Martin-Weston Ski Track. The RFP schedule lists a mandatory site visit September 21, questions due September 22, and proposals due October 15, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. EDT.
why: Official DCR RFP is currently open
Direct multi-service operating opportunity
October 15 submission deadline is verified in the RFP

items.title: Massachusetts utilities' 1,000 MW energy-storage RFP remains open through October 8
items.business: Eversource, National Grid and Unitil with Massachusetts DOER
items.description: Section 83E Round II seeks long-term contracts for approximately 1,000 MW of mid-duration energy storage. The revised official timeline sets proposal submissions for October 8, 2026 at noon EDT and the ShareFile URL-request deadline for October 2.
why: Official competitive procurement for approximately 1,000 MW
Revised October 8 proposal deadline is current
High-value statewide infrastructure opportunity
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Clean Energy / DOER and Distribution Companies

items.title: Healthpeak's roughly 5 million-square-foot Alewife Quadrangle plan received Cambridge Planning Board approval
items.description: Reporting on the September 15 Planning Board meeting says Healthpeak received approval for special permits for its roughly 5 million-square-foot, approximately $4.5 billion Alewife Quadrangle plan. The project is expected to be phased over many years. This is a development milestone, not evidence that any particular vendor contract is currently available.
likelyNeeds: Future tenant fitout and facility services
why: Major entitlement milestone reported September 16
Very large, multi-phase Cambridge development
Adjacent needs are plausible but remain inferred until procurement is announced
items.sourceName: Bisnow / City of Cambridge planning materials

items.title: Emergent BioSolutions marked the restart and growth of its Canton manufacturing facility
items.description: Emergent held a September 16 ribbon-cutting around the restart and growth of its Canton biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility. The company says it plans to add approximately 50 manufacturing, technical and operational positions. Related vendor needs are inferred from the expansion signal; no new vendor solicitation was announced in the company notice.
why: Company-confirmed manufacturing restart and site growth
Approximately 50 planned positions indicate operating expansion
Vendor demand is possible but not confirmed

items.title: Pressed Cafe is pursuing an alcohol-license transfer to a new Fenway location
items.description: Boston is holding a September 17 abutters meeting on Pressed Cafe's request to transfer its all-alcohol license from the Prudential Center location to a new Pressed Cafe at 126 Brookline Avenue. This is a licensing and relocation signal only; it is not evidence of an open vendor solicitation.
why: Current September 17 licensing milestone
New location is explicitly identified by the City
Likely operating needs are inferred, not confirmed purchases

items.title: First Watch plans to open a 6,700-square-foot Woburn restaurant on September 21
items.description: First Watch told Patch it plans to open its Woburn restaurant on September 21 at 19 Commerce Way. The roughly 6,700-square-foot location will have a bar, more than 200 seats and about 30 jobs. This is an opening signal; no vendor solicitation was reported.
why: Opening date and address were freshly confirmed September 16
Large restaurant footprint and roughly 30 jobs indicate active launch
Any third-party purchasing need is inferred rather than confirmed
